newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO SEIMITSU SHARES HIT NEW 1997 HIGH.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO SEIMITSU SHARES HIT NEW 1997 HIGH.

text.p: Shares of Tokyo Seimitsu Co Ltd hit a new high for this calender year on Wednesday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Tokyo Seimitsu shares climbed as high as 3,550 yen at 0139 GMT and ended the morning session at 3,500 yen, up 100 yen from Tuesday's close.
The previous calendar year high for Tokyo Seimitsu, which makes semiconductor-manufacturing equipment, was 3,430 yen marked on August 1.
"The company's share prices have been on a rising trend since it announced in late July it would buy back its own shares," a spokesman of a medium-sized Japanese brokerage said.
"The rise may also be part of the recent trend in which shares of some makers of semiconductor-producing equipment are firm," he said.
